# ferriskey_client_token_exchange_policy (Resource)

Manages a token exchange policy of a FerrisKey client, allowing it to exchange tokens for a target audience. The API has no update endpoint, so any change forces a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_client_token_exchange_policy" "app_to_api" {
  realm               = "acme"
  client_id           = ferriskey_client.app.client_uuid
  target_audience     = ferriskey_client.api.client_id
  allowed_scopes      = ["openid", "profile"]
  allow_delegation    = true
  allow_impersonation = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) UUID of the requesting client the policy belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the client belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `target_audience` (String) The `client_id` (not the UUID) of another client in the same realm that tokens may be exchanged for. It cannot be the requesting client itself. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `allow_delegation` (Boolean) Whether delegation exchanges are allowed. Defaults to `false`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `allow_impersonation` (Boolean) Whether impersonation exchanges are allowed. Defaults to `false`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `allowed_scopes` (Set of String) Ceiling of scopes the exchanged token may carry. Omit for no ceiling; an empty set is rejected by the API. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{client_id}/{policy_id}`.
- `policy_id` (String) Server-assigned UUID of the policy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_client_token_exchange_policy.app_to_api acme/1c0e2f3a-1111-2222-3333-444455556666/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
```
